hints.title: Keyboard Coordinate Mapping
hints.text: Map each character c to 2D coordinates: (r, col) = ((c - 65) // 6, (c - 65) % 6). Distance is Manhattan distance.

hints.title: Only Other Finger Matters
hints.text: At step i, one finger must be on word[i - 1]. Store dp[other_finger_char] as the min cost when the other finger is at that character.

hints.title: Transition Between Choices
hints.text: For letter word[i], move the current finger (same other finger) or move the other finger (current finger becomes other).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching on two finger assignments at every character takes 2^N operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since one finger is always at word[i-1], only 27 states (other finger position) need tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate optimizes state space by observing that one finger is anchored at the previous character.
complexity.notes: Initial state 26 represents a finger not yet placed on any key (cost 0 for first move).
